_about: SPEC_048: card length quality. real = invariants on real captions (tests/fixtures/transcript/), before = numbers from the pre-SPEC_048 code (for the report, not checked). cases = small synthetic cues with the exact expected card texts. Word counts only count tokens with a letter or digit. short = <= shortWords words, long = > longWords words, dangling = card (not the last) ends with a function word without punctuation (segmentBalance.isDanglingTail).
